title: Possessive Pronouns
subject: Language Arts
description: Words that show something belongs to someone — mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs!
curriculum: Jamaica NSC Grade 2 - Language Arts (Grammar & Conventions)
source: NSC Practice — built from the official MOE Grade 2 curriculum
nscObjectives: Identify possessive pronouns (mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs)
Use possessive words (my, your, his, her, our, their) before nouns
Choose the correct possessive word in sentences

sections.title: Words That Show Belonging
sections.description: Possessive words tell us WHO something belongs to.

questions.prompt: Which word shows that something belongs to someone?
questions.hint: 'This mango is MINE' — it belongs to me!

questions.prompt: Select ALL the words that show belonging:
questions.hint: 'Jump' is an action word — the others show who owns something

questions.prompt: That book belongs to me. The book is ___.
questions.hint: If it belongs to ME, it is MINE

questions.prompt: This pencil belongs to YOU. The pencil is ___.
questions.hint: Belongs to you → yours

questions.prompt: The football belongs to Marcus. The football is ___.
questions.hint: Marcus is a boy — something a boy owns is HIS

questions.prompt: The hair clip belongs to Abigail. The hair clip is ___.
questions.hint: Abigail is a girl — something a girl owns is HERS

questions.prompt: The classroom belongs to all of us. The classroom is ___.
questions.hint: Belongs to US → OURS

questions.prompt: The goats belong to the farmers. The goats are ___.
questions.hint: Belongs to THEM → THEIRS

sections.title: My, Your, His, Her, Our, Their
sections.description: These little words come BEFORE a noun to show who owns it: MY bag, YOUR shoe, HER book.

questions.prompt: ___ school bag is heavy. (the bag belongs to me)
questions.hint: Before a noun like 'bag', use MY — not MINE

questions.prompt: Is this ___ lunch box? (the lunch box belongs to you)
questions.hint: Before the noun 'lunch box', use YOUR

questions.prompt: Jevaughn lost ___ pencil.
questions.hint: Jevaughn is a boy — use HIS before 'pencil'

questions.prompt: Shanice loves ___ new shoes.
questions.hint: Shanice is a girl — use HER before 'shoes'

questions.prompt: We cleaned ___ classroom today.
questions.hint: WE did it together, so it's OUR classroom

questions.prompt: The birds built ___ nest in the mango tree.
questions.hint: More than one bird → THEIR nest

questions.prompt: Match the person to the right possessive word:
questions.hint: me → my, a boy → his, many people → their

questions.prompt: Fill in the missing word: 'The dog wagged ___ tail.' (one dog)
questions.hint: For ONE animal or thing, use 'its' (no apostrophe!)

sections.title: Pick the Right Word
sections.description: Mine or my? Yours or your? Choose carefully!

questions.prompt: Which sentence is correct?
questions.hint: MINE stands alone at the end; MY needs a noun after it

questions.prompt: Which sentence is correct?
questions.hint: YOURS stands alone; YOUR needs a noun after it

questions.prompt: The crayons belong to Tom and Ann. The crayons are ___.
questions.hint: Tom AND Ann = more than one person → THEIRS

questions.prompt: 'Is this bag yours or ___?' asked the teacher.
questions.hint: No noun after the word, so use MINE

questions.prompt: Select ALL the sentences that are written correctly:
questions.hint: HERS stands alone; OUR comes before a noun like 'team'

questions.prompt: Grandma said, 'This recipe was ___ mother's, and now it is ___.'
questions.hint: MY before 'mother's'; YOURS standing alone at the end
